label: Gouda
aka: Fromage Gouda de bière du Battin

about.text: Gouda cheese is a family of yellow cow's milk cheeses originally from the Netherlands. Gouda ranges from young and elastic to old and hard, and from low-fat to high-fat.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: Boerenkaas, made from unpasteurised milk on about 300 farms, mostly in South Holland; young cheese is ready after about six weeks
Dutch stages run from young (about 4 weeks) to very old (12 to 21 months); the cheese gets harder with age
A local Gouda-type cheese from unpasteurised cow's milk, in the style of Belgian monastery cheeses with Flemish influence; its name refers to Battin beer, whose role is not confirmed
Uniekaas is a Dutch brand of Goudse kaas, made from 1965 for KaasUnie; its producer claims it is the oldest Dutch cheese brand
